_about: Max damage plan per class (hand-written). Level order with the specialty picks at each skill level, what each step is worth, and what automating costs. Numbers come from data/topplayers.json (NotMeter Global top-20 parses per boss, week of Oct 7 2026; Korea top-20 builds) unless the text says otherwise. 'gain' is an estimate of total DPS from that step for a player at the same gear, worked out as (that skill's share of damage) x (the measured change in its casts or damage per cast).

chanter.sum: Every Chanter decision runs through Dark Crush. Option 5 (no cooldown, skill level 16) is worth more than anything else you can buy: top Global Chanters with it cast 27 Dark Crush a minute in boss fights, players without it cast 7. Get Dark Crush to 16 first, then Onslaught to 16 for Storm Chain, the clearest difference between the top 10% and everyone else.

order.why: 20% of damage, plus 10% more from its Piercing Strike chain. Option 5 removes the cooldown, so every macro press inside a 2 s window is another Dark Crush (3.7x the casts). Option 3 made each Dark Crush hit 47% harder in the data.
steps: swap 4 for 5 (no cooldown). At equal combat power 3+5 beat 4+5 by ~5% (102 vs 65 players)

order.why: Your held left click. Option 4 cuts Spinning Strike's cooldown on every hit, which means more Dark Crush windows. Option 5 adds Storm Chain (6% of damage on its own); 81% of the top-10% Global Chanters have it, against about half of everyone else.
steps: −1 s Spinning Strike cooldown per hit

order.why: 12% of damage and your main Dark Crush opener. Never drop option 1: players without it measured 4–5% lower. Option 5 made each cast 29% stronger.
The filler row. With its Bursting Blow chain it's 28% of a top Chanter's damage, so the Lv 16 multi-hit (+19% per cast) is worth it after the three above.
steps: −20% MP (option 4 is only an accuracy debuff)

order.why: 2% damage; it's here to open Dark Crush. 73% of top players run 3+4.

auto: Dark Crush, Piercing Strike, Spinning Strike, Impactful Crush and Incandescent Blow (with Bursting Blow) fire from the macro; Onslaught's chain, Storm Chain and Wind's Promise procs come from holding left click. Only Marchutan's Wrath and Rushing Smash (≈2% together) are left to press.

The stack order (Dark Crush first, then its two openers, then filler) is the same priority a perfect player follows, so the macro only gives up its 13 ms delay and the odd filler cast just before a window opens. Chanter is the most macro-friendly class in the game right now.

Whole boss fights, downtime included: median top-20 Global Chanter 26/min, top 10% 30/min. The few who hold 50–55/min in boss fights did ~20% more than their combat power predicts. Without option 5 you'll see 5–9/min: that's normal until 16.

It opens a 3 s window but costs a cast and deals <1% at stigma level 1–5. Chanters who cast it often measured ~5% lower at equal power, so press it only when Spinning Strike and Impactful Crush are both on cooldown.
Global Chanters who used it measured 4–8% lower at equal combat power. Hold it only while a boss's stagger bar is up.
chanter.stig: Global top players: Marchutan's Wrath 98%, Undefeated Mantra 97% (at 20), Sprint Mantra 90% (5–10), Power of the Storm 85% (5–10). Guardian Blessing is the swap (28%). Undefeated and Sprint are party buffs; the same 4 as this page's Global build.

sorcerer.sum: Hellfire (21%), Blaze (14%), Fire Wall (12%), Bittercold Wind and Firestorm (9% each) and Cold Storm (7%) are 72% of a top Global Sorcerer's damage. The rotation has two engines: every Firestorm cuts Hellfire's cooldown, and Flame Arrow's Pyroclasm resets Blaze. Build those two first.

order.why: Option 4 takes 2 s off Hellfire per fireball. Top Sorcerers cast ~12 Firestorms a minute, so that's ~24 s of Hellfire cooldown a minute, the reason they get 5–6 Hellfires instead of 2–3. 2+4 measured slightly ahead of 4+5 at equal power; take 5 at 20 (+55% Firestorm damage).
Your biggest hit. Option 5 (−15 s) gave 40% more Hellfires (5.6 vs 4.0 a minute). Option 1 makes the charge faster, which matters because you hold it to Max every time.

Your held left click and its Pyroclasm chain. Option 4 keeps Fire Mark on the target so Blaze is always usable; option 5 resets Blaze: 34% more Blaze casts. The top 10% cast 34 Blaze a minute vs 23 for the median player.

14% of damage. Option 4 (multi-hit) measured +26% per cast. At 16, Est's Global guide calls option 5 mandatory (−3 s Wish of Concentration per hit); 3+4 and 3+5 measured the same, so take 5 if you press Wish on cooldown.
steps: −3 s Wish of Concentration per hit

order.why: +10% Attack (option 2) and +10% Combat Speed (option 4) on a buff Blaze keeps resetting. Korea runs it at 20 for −10 s on every cooldown.
9% of damage, but its picks are cheap: 58% of top players run 1+4.

auto: A macro fires it uncharged. In Global parses a tap does ~40–70k vs ~100–150k for Max, and Hellfire is 21% of damage. Keep it on its own key and hold it to Max.
Fire Wall + Cold Storm by hand

Together 19% of damage. The top 10% land 35–37 hits a minute from each vs 24–29 for the median player. If you forget them when the boss moves, the 6-entry in-game macro (Other versions) fires them for you and loses less than missing casts.

Est's guide weaves Ice Chain on Global because cooldowns are long. Two thirds of top-10% parses don't cast it at all, and the players who do measured +3% (±2.4), inside the noise. Skip it unless you're short on MP.
One filler line on the macro (Blaze, Firestorm, Winter's Shackles, Frost Burst) plus Flame Arrow held; everything that decides burst stays on keys you press so it lines up.
sorcerer.stig: Global top players: Element Enhancement 100% (15–20), Fire Wall 99%, Delayed Explosion 97%, Cold Storm 88%. Players without Cold Storm measured ~3% lower. Same 4 as this page.

ranger.sum: Deadshot (23%) and Tempest Shot (17.5%) carry the class, then Drill Dart (11%). The cheapest big upgrade in the game is Snipe option 4 at skill level 12: it cuts Deadshot's cooldown on every Snipe hit, and Global Rangers with it cast 2.3x as many Deadshots.

order.why: Your held left click. Option 4 (−1 s Deadshot cooldown per hit) is why top Rangers fire 6–7 Deadshots a minute instead of ~3. Option 5 at 16 adds the Tempest Arrow chain (~3% of damage; the top 10% cast it 13 times a minute).
Option 5 adds a second hit: +53% damage per Deadshot in the data. Option 2 speeds up the charge; option 3 lets you charge while moving (Global top players: 2+3 and 2+5 are the two most common).
Option 5 fires Drill Dart twice: ~1.9x damage per cast. Players with 3+5 measured ~5% ahead of 3+4 at equal power.
Your most-cast skill (~100 a minute). Option 3 measured +9% per cast; option 5 gave 12% more casts. 76% of top Global Rangers already have it at 16.
Gale is +7% Combat Speed and +7% PvE damage. Option 5 (−10 s) gave 1.9x the casts, which keeps it up the whole fight.
4% of damage; 3+4 is what 45% of top players run. Option 5 at 16 gave 26% more casts if you have levels to spare.

auto: A macro fires it uncharged: ~35–45% of a Max charge in Global parses, and Deadshot is 23% of damage. Hold it yourself.
Korean testing: Tempest Shot at the top of a different entry from the short-cooldown skills gives more Tempest Shot hits. This page's Late card does this.

Vaizel's Authority, Bow of Blessing and Supporting Fire fire on cooldown, which top players do anyway (Supporting Fire 47 hits/min for the top 10%). Check Snipe stays at 16–18 a minute on the dummy; if it drops, press the buffs yourself.
ranger.stig: Global top players: Vaizel's Authority 99% (at 20), Bow of Blessing 98% (10), Supporting Fire 95% (10–15), Griffon Arrow 62%. Explosive Arrow (39%) measured ~4% lower than Griffon Arrow as the 4th. Same 4 as this page.

assassin.sum: Heart Gore (25–28%) and Insignia Explosion (20%) are half your damage, and you have to hit from behind: top Global Assassins land 85% of hits on the back. Heart Gore fires off crits, so it runs itself once your crit is high. The real upgrades are Insignia Explosion casts (Quick Slice option 4, then Insignia Explosion option 5) and pressing Illusive Clone, which the median player barely does.

order.why: Your held left click. Option 4 takes 1 s off Insignia Explosion per hit: players with it cast 1.55x as many Insignia Explosions. Option 5 (guaranteed crit) didn't raise Heart Gore casts in the data, so it can wait.
steps: −1 s Insignia Explosion cooldown per hit

order.why: 20% of damage. Option 5 (−3 s) gave 35% more casts; option 2 (multi-hit) +12% per cast. 2+5 and 2+3 measured even, 3+5 ~5% lower, so always keep 2.

Your biggest skill. Option 4 (multi-hit) measured +21% per cast. Option 5 (reset on crit) only added ~6% more casts on Global, because your crit already brings it back fast; take it at 16, not before Insignia Explosion.
The Savage Roar chain is ~10% of damage. 2+4 measured 3–4% ahead of 2+3: option 4 gave 1.5x Shadowstrikes, and Shadowstrike's option 2 is +20% crit damage for 5 s.
2% of damage, only on staggered bosses; 4+5 is what both Global and Korea run.

auto: Top Global Assassins: 85% of hits from behind, 8% from the front. Rear Smite, Ambush (+30%) and Triniel's Dagger (+30%) are back-attack skills, and Korea's top 20 put Back Attack Damage Boost on every manastone. Every hit from the front loses all of that.
Removes Heart Gore's cooldown and adds 20% of your damage for 10 s. The top 10% cast it about once a minute; most median players' parses show no cast at all. Press it with Swift Contract.
Macro line with Ambush in row 1
Ambush is in 70% of top Global parses. Its option 1 engraves 2 Insignias on a back attack, which feeds Insignia Explosion. It's the Korean Sep 30 optimizer line and now this page's Late card.
Heart Gore is crit-triggered and everything else in the line is priority-ordered, so the macro plays it the way you would. What the macro can't do is stand behind the boss or time Illusive Clone.
assassin.stig: Global top players: Illusive Clone 100% (15–20), Swift Contract 100% (15), Triniel's Dagger 90%, then Evasion Stance 58% or Savage Fang 44% as the 4th. Evasion Stance is the survival pick; Savage Fang is the damage pick (it engraves 5 Insignias) but didn't measure ahead on Global yet.

gladiator.sum: Overhead Slam and its Upward Strike chain are 60% of a Gladiator's damage. Option 3 (the Upward Strike chain) at skill level 8 and option 5 (no cooldown) at 16 aren't optional. Every top Global Gladiator has Overhead Slam at 16+, and over 80% of the top 10% have it at 20.

order.why: Option 3 adds Upward Strike, 22% of damage by itself. Option 4 (crit) measured +31% per cast. Option 5 removes the cooldown so it can be spammed in every Rage Burst window. Top 10%: 59 Overhead Slams and 49 Upward Strikes a minute.

The other half of the Overhead Slam ↔ Rending Blow alternation (~52 casts a minute for the top 10%), plus its Smashing Blow chain: 21% of damage together. Option 5 restores MP on crits; the Global sheet warns you'll run short on MP until you have it.
8% of damage plus Prepare for Battle (+20% PvE damage for 20 s on a 45 s cooldown). Option 4 measured +21% per cast.
Only usable on staggered targets. Korea runs 4+5 at 16; on Global it's 1–2% of damage.

auto: The macro alternates the two (the 内絕 cancel). The top 10% cast 59 Overhead Slam and 52 Rending Blow a minute in boss fights. If you're well under 45 Overhead Slams, the macro isn't reaching its Overhead Slam entry often enough.
The Global sheet's layout leaves it to you. Prepare for Battle is +20% PvE damage, and top players keep it on cooldown (2.9 casts a minute), so this page now fires it from the macro's first entry.
Top Global Gladiators cast Keen Strike ~3 times a minute: the macro keeps them busy. Hold it only while you're short on MP (before Rending Blow option 5).
gladiator.stig: Global top players: Rage Burst 100% (kept at 5 for −15 s), Lunge Stance 99% (at 20), Zikel's Blessing 94% (10–15), then Focused Block 70% as the survival 4th. Wave Armor (this page's damage 4th) is rare on Global (11%) but measured +4% (±3.7); Lifestealing Blade (25%) measured −2%.

templar.sum: Judgment is 38–40% of a Templar's damage, and option 5 (no cooldown, skill level 16) gives five times the Judgments. Before 16 it's a different class. Second is Vicious Strike option 4 at skill level 12: Warding Strike's cooldown drops on every hit, and each Warding Strike opens Judgment.

order.why: 38 Judgments a minute with option 5 vs 8 without. Options 3 and 4 measured about the same (+5–7% per cast); 4+5 is the most common Global pick.
Your held left click. Option 4 (−2 s Warding Strike per hit) gave 2.5x Warding Strikes and 1.6x Judgments. Option 5 adds Threatening Blow (4% of damage), and the top 10% all use it.
steps: −2 s Warding Strike cooldown per hit

order.why: Pummel and its Punishing Strike are 11% of damage. Option 4 (−1 s Punishment per Punishing Strike) gave 36% more Punishments.
12% of damage. Hold it to Max. Option 5 measured +29% per cast; option 3 charges faster.
Opens Judgment. Option 1 gave 24% more casts.
Also opens Judgment and stuns for Annihilate. Option 4 gave 22% more casts.

auto: Uncharged Punishment does ~30–45% of a Max in Global parses, and it's 12% of damage. Keep it on its own key.
0.8% of damage, and its −25% Defense barely matters on bosses (Defense only removes 10% of its value in PvE). Two thirds of the top 10% don't cast it at all, so its row is now empty.
Judgment sits on row 0 of the main entry, right above its openers, so the macro casts it the moment a window opens, which is what you'd do by hand.
templar.stig: Global top players: Taunt 83%, Battlefield Banner 79% (15–20), Noble Armor 72% (15), Doom Shield 68% (5) or Shield of Protection 60% (5). Players without Taunt measured ~4% lower. Same 4 as this page.

spiritmaster.sum: Spiritmaster damage is spread out: Elemental Fusion 16%, Combustion 9% (+6% from its Ashy Call chain), Dimensional Control 7%, then the spirits. About a third of it lands whatever you press (spirit basic attacks ~13% plus the spirit skills they fire by themselves ~21%), so the macro matters less than on any other class. Get Combustion to 16 for Ashy Call first.

order.why: Your filler. Option 5 adds Ashy Call (6% of damage, 30 casts a minute); option 4 gave 23% more casts.
Your biggest hit, fed by every spirit skill. Option 3 measured +12% per cast. Leave option 4 (charge) alone: a macro can't charge it.
Korea's top 20 run it at 20 (2+3+5). The Fire Spirit's skills and basic attacks are ~11% of damage.
3% of damage plus the Curse; 54% of top players run 3+4.
Held left click. 69% of top players run 3+4 (+2% Attack stacks from Earth Tremor).

auto: Spirit basic attacks and the skills spirits fire by themselves (15% chance per hit; Ancient Spirit every 7 attacks) land whatever you press, so Spiritmaster loses the least when the macro (or you) slip.
Its Plasma Cannon, Destruction and basic attacks are ~14% of damage, and every skill it uses grants Four Elements. The top 10% get 25% more Plasma Cannons than the median.
Option 4 turns it into a charge skill; a macro would fire it uncharged.
spiritmaster.stig: Global top players: Summon: Ancient Spirit 100%, Enhance: Spirit's Benediction 100% (10), Jointstrike: Corrode 98%, Flame Blessing 80% (10). Same 4 as this page.

cleric.sum: Condemnation is 35% of a Cleric's damage, and option 4 resets its cooldown on every crit: the top 10% cast 40 a minute vs 30 for the median player. Judgment Thunder (with Divine Punishment) is another 25%. Cleric is a healer first; these picks are for when you can deal damage.

order.why: Option 4 is in every top Global build (reset on crit). Option 5 measured +14% per cast.
Held filler whose Divine Punishment chain is 15% of damage. 67% of top players have option 5 (Divine Punishment 1 extra time).
Option 4 takes 7 s off Bolt every time Discharge procs. Korea runs it at 20.
8% of damage. Hold it to Max. Option 5 measured +42% per cast.
Condemnation only works on targets with it. Option 4 is a −10% PvE Damage Tolerance debuff on the boss for your whole party; 95% of top players run 2+4.

auto: Uncharged Bolt is ~35–45% of a Max, and it's 8% of damage.
It's a party buff. Clerics who slot it measured ~5% lower themselves, but your party gains more than you lose. Keep it.
cleric.stig: Global top players: Earth Punishment 98% (at 20), Prayer of Amplification 91% (10), Noble Aura 90% (10), then Salvation 33% or Light of Protection 32%.
